insights.headline: Gold holds below $3,700 and silver under $45 as Fed hike bets bite
insights.summary: Spot gold stayed below $3,700 an ounce, a 14-month low, while silver held under $45 — down nearly two-thirds from above $121 in January, against gold's roughly one-third fall from near $5,600. MCX gold stayed below Rs 1.30 lakh per 10 g, down Rs 12,400 since November 9, with silver near Rs 1.60 lakh per kg. Morgan Stanley still named gold its top commodity pick for 2027 at $5,250 an ounce, citing ETF and central-bank demand, while China's central bank stretched its buying streak to 24 months.
points: Spot gold held below $3,700, a 14-month low; silver stayed under $45, down nearly two-thirds from its January peak above $121.
MCX gold stayed below Rs 1.30 lakh per 10 g, down Rs 12,400 since November 9; silver held near Rs 1.60 lakh per kg.
Morgan Stanley named gold its top commodity pick for 2027 at $5,250 an ounce, citing ETF and central-bank demand.
China's central bank extended its gold-buying streak to 24 months, and festive gold sales value rose 15–25% despite high prices.
Bank of America expects silver to reach $75 an ounce in 2027, with its model showing an 852-tonne deficit next year.

trending.title: Fed hike bets keep bullion under pressure
trending.summary: Hawkish Fed minutes, firm jobless claims and a strong dollar have pushed gold to a fresh 14-month low of $3,670, with markets pricing about a 90% chance of a quarter-point December hike.

trending.title: Silver's slide meets falling vault stocks
trending.summary: Silver slipped to $44.44, yet London's vaults shed metal for the first time in six months, India's October silver imports nearly tripled, and Bank of America still sees $75 an ounce in 2027.

trending.title: Festive demand holds up despite high prices
trending.summary: Festive gold sales value jumped 15-25% despite high prices, according to WGC data, even as gold trades about 29% below its January peak.

trending.title: India's import bill shrinks as prices bite
trending.summary: India's gold import bill is shrinking as high prices and the duty hike curb buying, with imports seen falling to $40 billion in FY27.

trending.title: Central banks still buying on dips
trending.summary: China's central bank added 26 tonnes in October, its 24th straight month of buying, while central banks bought 675 tonnes in January-September.

items.title: Gold prices fall Rs 12,400 since November 9; silver slips to Rs 1.62 lakh per kg
items.summary: Delhi gold fell Rs 1,300 to Rs 1,34,500 per 10 g, down Rs 12,400 in eight sessions since November 9, while silver slipped to Rs 1,62,000 per kg, PTI reported. The slide extends the post-Diwali correction as a firm dollar and Fed hike bets keep bullion under pressure.

items.title: Gold's 14-month low looks mild next to Silver's fall from $121 to $44
items.summary: Gold is trading below $3,700, down about a third from its near-$5,600 record in late January, while silver has fallen nearly two-thirds from above $121 to under $45. FXStreet puts the gap down to central-bank buying supporting gold, with no equivalent buyer for silver, as Fed rate-hike bets drive both metals lower.

items.title: Gold the top commodity pick for 2027 even as broader commodities likely to underperform – Morgan Stanley
items.summary: Morgan Stanley named gold its top commodity pick for 2027, seeing $5,250 an ounce by the fourth quarter, as ETF and central-bank demand holds up even while the bank stays underweight commodities overall. It expects oil to ease to $75 a barrel by late 2027.

items.title: Gold and Silver Sink Again in China, Then London, as Anthropic Floats
items.summary: Gold and silver sank to fresh 14-month lows on Thursday, first in Shanghai and then in London, as global shares fell for a seventh straight session. Gold fixed at ¥801 per gram in Shanghai, its lowest since September 2025, then dropped to $3,670 an ounce in London; silver fell to $44.44, its cheapest since September last year, as Anthropic's $81 billion float topped the day's equity news.

items.title: Gold price approaches $3,700/oz after U.S. weekly jobless claims rise to 203k
items.summary: US initial jobless claims rose to 203,000 for the week ending November 14, above the 197,000 economists expected, and spot gold traded near $3,715 an ounce, Kitco reported. Gold held just above $3,700 after dipping to a 14-month low earlier in the session.

items.title: Gold drops to 14-month low as dollar, yields rise on hawkish Fed rhetoric
items.summary: Spot gold sank 3.2% to $3,726 an ounce, its lowest since September 2025, after the Fed's October minutes showed most officials see further rate hikes and Governor Waller backed a possible half-point December rise. US gold futures settled at $3,741.90, silver slid 5% to $45.03 and platinum fell 4.1%, as the dollar hit a 19-month high.

items.title: Leveraged silver speculators wrong-footed by price crash
items.summary: Indian investors who borrowed heavily to bet on silver through exchange-traded funds face steep losses as prices sit about 60% below their January peak, while still paying interest on the borrowed money. Margin-funded positions in Nippon India Silver BeES stood at Rs 1,058 crore on November 16, among the largest on the NSE and BSE, after Indian silver ETFs drew a record Rs 9,463 crore in January.

items.title: Gold edges up from 14-month low as markets assess Fed rate outlook
items.summary: Spot gold rose 0.3% to $3,733.76 an ounce by 0630 GMT on Thursday after touching $3,693.13, its lowest since September 2025, as traders weighed hawkish Fed signals; markets price a 90% chance of a 25-basis-point December hike and 10% for a half-point move, while silver rose 0.8% to $45.38.

items.title: Gold Rebounds as Iran Tensions Escalate, but $3,667 Support Faces a Test
items.summary: Gold rebounded as tensions with Iran escalated, Investing.com reported, though the $3,667 level remains a key support to watch after the slide to a 14-month low.

items.title: Gold price falls as Fed hike odds jump and GLD, IAU ETF outflows surge
items.summary: Gold stayed under pressure near $3,728 as traders priced in another Fed rate hike, with the SPDR Gold ETF seeing $1.37 billion of outflows in 30 days and the iShares Gold Trust shedding $279 million, Invezz reported.

items.title: Gold (XAUUSD) & Silver Price Forecast: Gold Stuck Near 14-Month Low as Fed Hike Bets Build, Can $3,707 Hold?
items.summary: Gold held near its lowest since September 2025 at about $3,735, with support at $3,690 and resistance at $3,820, FXEmpire said, as CME FedWatch priced a 90% chance of a quarter-point December hike and a 10% chance of a half-point move. Silver traded near $45.39, below its $45.70 pivot.

items.title: Silver Investors Should Watch the Vaults, Not Just the Price
items.summary: Silver slipped below $45 an ounce, but London's vaults shed metal in October — the first fall in six months — and COMEX deliverable stocks barely moved, suggesting the sell-off is not driven by surplus metal. India's October silver imports nearly tripled to $1.91 billion, while Metals Focus and the Silver Institute still forecast a sixth straight annual supply deficit of about 35 Moz.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD languishes around $45.00 amid Fed hiking bets
items.summary: Silver consolidated near $45 an ounce after touching a fresh 14-month low of $44.54, staying on the defensive as the dollar rallied on hawkish Fed minutes and Governor Waller's remarks reviving talk of a larger December hike. Analysts at ING said the market has got the message that the Fed needs to take rates higher to bring inflation back to target.

items.title: Gold futures slide near Rs 1.29 lakh, silver below Rs 1.60 lakh on MCX amid hawkish Fed signals: Should investors buy the dip?
items.summary: MCX December gold futures opened 0.75% lower at Rs 1,28,842 per 10 g and silver slipped to Rs 1,59,960 per kg in early trade, as a firmer dollar, rising yields and hawkish Fed commentary kept pressure on bullion. Spot gold hovered just above $3,711 an ounce and silver near $45, with cross-asset selling as a tech-led equity correction forces liquidation.

items.title: MCX Gold trades below ₹1.30 lakh per 10 gram, Silver price falls below ₹1.6 lakh per kg; check trade setup for Nov 19
items.summary: MCX December gold futures traded near ₹1,29,274 per 10 g and silver near ₹1,60,600 per kg in the afternoon session, with spot gold around $3,733 an ounce and silver near $45.01, as a firm dollar and Fed hike bets kept the metals under pressure. Gold held just above support at ₹1,28,412, with resistance at ₹1,38,249.

items.title: Silver gets ₹24,000/kg cheaper in 1 week: Gold prices fall ₹12,000/10 gm in as many days
items.summary: Gold has become about Rs 12,000 cheaper per 10 g and silver about Rs 24,000 cheaper per kg over seven trading sessions, IBJA data shows, with 24-carat gold at Rs 1.30 lakh per 10 g and silver at Rs 1.62 lakh per kg on November 19. IBJA puts silver's January 29 high at Rs 3.80 lakh per kg, Rs 2.18 lakh above today's level.

items.title: Gold falls to Rs 130,200/10 grams, silver plunges to Rs 161,054/kg, sharp downslide continues on MCX
items.summary: MCX gold was trading around Rs 1,30,200 per 10 g and silver around Rs 1,61,054 per kg, extending a slide that has run for 15 straight sessions on profit booking, a stronger dollar and Fed rate-hike concerns. In Nagpur's Itwari Sarafa market, gold was Rs 1,31,000 per 10 g and silver Rs 1,63,000 per kg.

items.title: Gold Prices Fall As US Fed Rate Hike Fears Grow, Silver Futures Rise On MCX
items.summary: MCX December silver futures rose Rs 768, or 0.48%, to Rs 1,61,500 per kg even as gold futures fell Rs 483 to Rs 1,29,331 per 10 g, IANS reported. Gold traded below Rs 1.30 lakh as Fed rate-hike fears kept pressure on bullion.

items.title: Gold was at Rs 1.81 lakh at the start of 2026, and now it has crashed almost 29% to Rs 1.29 lakh per 10 g
items.summary: Gold has crashed almost 29% from Rs 1.81 lakh per 10 g at the start of 2026 to about Rs 1.29 lakh, the Times of India reported. MCX gold futures edged down Rs 44 to Rs 1,29,770 per 10 g on Thursday as spot demand stayed subdued, while international gold held near $3,740 an ounce.

items.title: Gold, silver prices tumble to 1-year lows: What is driving the precious metals crash?
items.summary: Gold and silver tumbled to one-year lows, Fortune India reported, as a stronger dollar and expectations of further Fed rate hikes weighed on bullion. The selloff extends a slide that has taken spot gold to its lowest since September 2025.

items.title: Bank of America Sees $75 Silver: Pan American's Upside
items.summary: Bank of America expects silver to reach $75 an ounce in 2027 as macroeconomic pressures ease and the market returns to deficit, its analysts say. The bank's model projects a 910-tonne surplus in 2026 turning into an 852-tonne deficit in 2027, with $75 averages in the second and third quarters and $70 for the full year; Pan American Silver is named as a likely beneficiary.

items.title: China Extends Gold-Buying Streak to 24 Months as Beijing Bucks the Price Slump
items.summary: China's central bank added 26 tonnes of gold in October, its 24th consecutive month of buying, lifting reserves to 2,435 tonnes, while central banks bought 675 tonnes in January-September. Goldman Sachs cut its end-2027 gold forecast to $4,650 an ounce from $4,800.

items.title: Festive gold sales value jumps 15-25 pc despite high prices: WGC
items.summary: Festive gold sales value rose 15-25% year-on-year over Dhanteras-Diwali, the World Gold Council said, while volumes were largely flat to slightly higher as average festive prices ran nearly 10% above last year. October gold imports were $5.51 billion, more than triple September's but 63% lower than a year earlier.

items.title: India Rupee Review: Steady as FII inflows offset importers' dollar demand
items.summary: The rupee ended broadly steady at 93.44 per dollar on Wednesday, after opening at 93.4050, as foreign institutional inflows offset dollar purchases by public-sector banks for importers. The currency had touched a seven-month high in early trade before giving back gains as the dollar strengthened. Dealers said RBI maturities in the non-deliverable forward market also weighed.

items.title: $32 Billion Squeeze: Why India's Massive Gold Import Bill Is Shrinking Fast
items.summary: India's gold import bill could fall to $35-40 billion in FY27 from nearly $72 billion in FY26, NDTV Profit reports, with gold imports down about 40% to $24.78 billion in April-October. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal attributed the fall to the higher customs duty introduced in May, which made overseas purchases more expensive.

items.title: Gold imports may fall to $40 bn in FY27 on duty hike: Commerce Secy
items.summary: India's gold imports may fall to $40 billion in FY27 as the higher import duty curbs demand, the Commerce Secretary said, Business Standard reported. The May duty hike to 15% has already shrunk import volumes, easing pressure on the rupee and the trade deficit.
